answer: Random beacon audit with a compute heartbeat: each epoch the beacon spot-checks 5% of identities. A picked agent has 10 minutes to prove a slice of work from its receipt chain, a river of proofs. A miss burns its bond and freezes it 20 epochs, and each miss sends a ripple through the log. 100 fakes need 100 bonds of 60 days' earnings, 6,000 days at stake, while forgery costs spiral upward. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps every reward.
